title: Feature request: Adjustable timestamp for notes (in treatments)
symptom: The issue requests the addition of a 'notes' field to the treatment input, next to finger glucose, meal carbs and bolus injections, to jot down observations related to the treatment. The user also notes that there is no way to add a timestamped note without an existing treatment entry, and carbs are rounded up to the next full gram.
evidence_quote: This feature requests asks for the addition of a "notes" field to the treatment input, right next to finger glucose, meal carbs and bolus injections.
